'''2009 Worlds Team Tournament Adam Nelson DS Agents Of Black Sun''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Adam Nelson]] at [[2009 World Championship]] (Team Tournament).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Black Sun]]
* '''Username:''' aardvark2003
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Team Tournament
